scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @k8s-ui/api" "npm run dev --workspace @k8s-ui/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @k8s-ui/api && npm run build --workspace @k8s-ui/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @k8s-ui/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @k8s-ui/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @k8s-ui/api && npm run test --workspace @k8s-ui/web
